text.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَمَرُوا۟ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْا۟ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ

words.gloss_range: relative classifier for the defended group, whose identity is completed by the condition and four responses
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) does not start a self-contained new label; it carries forward the defended group from the previous boundary (22:40). The relative form makes identity unfold through the condition and the four actions, so the group is known by empowered conduct rather than by a bare title.

topics.headline: relative opener continues the defended group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins inside the defended-group chain from 22:40 rather than launching an unrelated class.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is syntactically dependent and boundary evidence resolves the antecedent in 22:40.

topics.headline: identity completed by condition and conduct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the group defined by the conditional conduct that follows, with the plural form governing the later actor chain.
topics.reason: The masculine plural relative form controls the later suffix and plural verbs, and the sentence delays identity until conduct is described.

words.gloss_range: open conditional marker that makes empowerment the test-frame for the response chain
words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) makes the empowerment frame conditional and open. The reader meets power as a test: if establishment is granted, the immediate answer is the four-part chain that follows, not a settled claim of possession.

topics.headline: empowerment framed as open condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices empowerment as a contingent test-frame for all four acts, not as guaranteed possession.
topics.reason: The conditional particle governs the protasis and places the whole action chain under the if-frame.

topics.headline: apodosis follows without delay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the duties answer the condition immediately rather than being introduced as a separate explanation.
topics.reason: The jawāb begins at the first action verb with no added connector before it.

words.gloss_range: divinely caused establishment of the plural group within a land-domain, as an open condition for action
words.root_gloss_range: establishment, firmness, place, and capacity; the local Form II frame selects divinely caused empowerment rather than self-establishment
words.prose: {{ar:مَّكَّنَّٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:makkannāhum}}) fixes agency before any human duty appears: God is the establisher and the plural group are recipients. The Form II and placement field make empowerment feel like being made firm with capacity in a land-domain, and the doubled center gives that firmness a tightened sound. The conditional frame keeps it from becoming simple past narrative or self-made mastery.

topics.headline: God establishes the plural group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees empowerment as granted by God to the group, not generated by the group itself.
topics.reason: The first-person plural subject and object suffix fix agency and recipient, while the Form II surface blocks reflexive self-establishment.

topics.headline: completed form inside open condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the completed-looking verb functions inside an open if-clause.
topics.reason: The perfect form follows the conditional particle, so it serves the protasis rather than simple past narration.

topics.headline: establishment joins place and capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels establishment as situated capacity in a land-domain, while local grammar keeps it to this empowerment construction.
topics.reason: The root and co-occurrence evidence support place-and-capacity pressure, but the local phrase licenses it through the land complement rather than as a free abstract rank.

topics.headline: doubled form makes firm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees firmness concentrated in the causative Form II before the duty list begins.
topics.reason: The doubled Form II stem makes establishment an act of making firm, with the sound note reinforcing that same morphological pressure.

words.gloss_range: locative and domain-marking preposition that places empowerment inside an operating sphere
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) gives empowerment an inside-space. It turns the following land phrase into the operating sphere where prayer, giving, command, and restraint will be enacted, so the condition is public and domain-bound rather than merely inward.

topics.headline: inside-space for empowerment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that empowerment is located within an operating sphere before any duty is named.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the land noun and attaches the domain phrase to the empowerment verb.

words.gloss_range: the governed land-domain or public substrate in which empowerment becomes accountable action
words.root_gloss_range: ground, land, territory, and operational substrate; the local phrase selects the public terrestrial domain of empowerment
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) is not what God acts upon directly; it is the governed domain inside which the group is established. The land functions as public substrate and responsibility-space, with the ayah keeping attention on terrestrial governance rather than a heaven-earth contrast.

topics.headline: land is prepositional complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees land as the domain of establishment, not the direct object acted upon.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the locative preposition, so it functions as the governed sphere of empowerment.

topics.headline: land as public responsibility-space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the land as a concrete public substrate for communal duties, while the local phrase does not expand into a cosmic heaven-earth contrast.
topics.reason: Root and surah evidence support ground, territory, and operating-domain pressure; the absence of a heaven pair narrows the local focus to terrestrial responsibility.

words.gloss_range: causing prayer to stand as the first institutional response within the conditional apodosis
words.root_gloss_range: standing, making stand, uprightness, maintenance, and communal standing; the local Form IV selects causing prayer to stand as an institution
words.prose: {{ar:أَقَامُوا۟}} ({{tr:aqāmū}}) launches the answer to the condition and keeps the same plural actor from the relative opener. Its Form IV force makes the first duty more than performing prayer: the empowered community causes the practice to stand. God first establishes them, and they answer by establishing prayer, turning earlier faithful character (22:35) into enacted public response.

topics.headline: first verb launches the four-action answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that prayer-establishment begins the answer to empowerment and sets the rhythm for the remaining duties.
topics.reason: The verb is the first apodosis action with the same pro-dropped plural subject and the following verbs are coordinated with it.

topics.headline: causing prayer to stand
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the verb as institutional maintenance: the community causes the practice to stand, rather than merely standing itself.
topics.reason: The Form IV verb governs the prayer object directly, activating the established prayer formula and the standing-maintenance root field.

topics.headline: earlier character becomes enacted response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the move from faithful character in 22:35 to public action in 22:41, and from God establishing them to their establishing prayer.
topics.reason: The supplied echoes connect the same prayer-establishment field across 22:35 and 22:41 and set the human action as a response to divine establishment.

words.gloss_range: the recognized prayer practice as direct object, carrying practice, institution, and boundary-continuity pressure
words.root_gloss_range: prayer and close-following/supplication, with disputed nearness/intensity pressure; the local object remains the established worship practice
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣalāta}}) is the thing made to stand, a definite practice treated as an institution. The word also carries live root-pressure of connection and nearness, while the boundary from protected worship-spaces (22:40) to maintained worship-practice makes preservation happen through practice. Together with the following giving duty, it forms the first paired response: maintained worship and outward transfer.

topics.headline: prayer is the direct object made to stand
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees prayer as the recognized practice caused to stand, not merely a circumstance of standing.
topics.reason: The accusative definite gerund is the direct object of the establishment verb.

topics.headline: connection and nearness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels maintained connection and intensified nearness in the practice, while local grammar keeps the word as the established prayer object.
topics.reason: The root-dispute evidence gives real semantic pressure but does not replace the local object sense.

topics.headline: protected spaces become maintained practice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that threatened worship-spaces in 22:40 are answered by an empowered community maintaining worship-practice in 22:41.
topics.reason: The boundary rows connect protected plural worship-spaces in 22:40 with the singular practice established here.

topics.headline: first two duties form a paired response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first two actions as a familiar paired response: maintained worship and outward transfer.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence evidence marks prayer and the purifying due as a strong formula-pair.

words.gloss_range: coordinating link that gives the giving act equal rank with prayer-establishment
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) ties the giving act directly to prayer-establishment. Its compact coordination gives the first two duties equal rank inside one response to empowerment, with no temporal or causal detour.

topics.headline: connector balances the first couplet
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices prayer-establishment and giving as coequal actions in one conditional response.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second verb with the first and creates the first two-member couplet.

words.gloss_range: active delivery that makes the purifying due arrive as the second response to empowerment
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, and causing to come or giving; the local Form IV direct object frame selects active delivery of the due
words.prose: {{ar:ءَاتَوُا۟}} ({{tr:ātawu}}) keeps the same empowered actors and makes the due move as a direct object. The coming/giving root-pressure makes giving feel like causing resources to arrive; the vowel variant preserves pronunciation texture without changing that delivery profile, and the same pattern returns as command in 22:78.

topics.headline: direct object makes transfer immediate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same empowered actors making the due arrive directly, with no intermediary construction.
topics.reason: The verb shares the pro-dropped plural subject and takes the due as a direct object.

topics.headline: giving as causing to arrive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees giving as directed movement: resources must be made to arrive.
topics.reason: The Form IV stem from the coming/giving field supports active delivery of the object.

topics.headline: vowel variant preserves the action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices recitational texture without a change in duty, object, or agency.
topics.reason: The supplied variant changes final vowel sound while preserving the Form IV stem, plural subject, and direct object relation.

topics.headline: description returns as command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the described practice of 22:41 returns as an imperative uptake in 22:78.
topics.reason: The same prayer-and-giving pattern is described here and commanded later in 22:78.

words.gloss_range: the definite purifying and growth-producing due transferred outward as an institution
words.root_gloss_range: growth, increase, purity, and cleansing; the local noun selects the institutional due that is given outward
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:az-zakāta}}) is the transferred object, not merely an inward state. Its growth-and-purity pressure makes the outward due both cleansing and increase-producing, and its pairing with prayer keeps the response both devotional and social before the later command echo (22:78).

topics.headline: purifying due as direct object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees purification as an outward institutional object given through transfer, not only an inward quality.
topics.reason: The definite accusative noun is the object of the delivery verb and differs from reflexive self-purification forms.

topics.headline: growth and purity held together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the due as both cleansing and growth-producing, while the local noun keeps the sense institutional and transferable.
topics.reason: The root evidence joins growth and purification, but the local syntax selects the noun as the thing given.

topics.headline: giving paired with prayer and echoed later
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the due as the social counterpart to prayer, with the same duty returning in 22:78.
topics.reason: The contextual evidence links the prayer-and-giving pair and the later surah command.

words.gloss_range: serial coordinator that pivots from the prayer-and-giving pair into public norm-direction
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the third verb with the same serial form as the earlier connector. The reader feels a pivot from the prayer-and-giving pair into public norm-direction without losing equal rank in the conditional answer.

topics.headline: connector opens the governance pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the list pivot from maintained worship and transfer into public norm-direction without breaking the apodosis.
topics.reason: The repeated conjunction adds the third perfect verb in the same parallel chain.

words.gloss_range: public enjoining by relation to the recognized good, with human command framed inside the larger matter-field
words.root_gloss_range: command, matter, affair, authority, and ordering; the local verb selects human enjoining while the closing noun returns the whole matter-field to God
words.prose: {{ar:أَمَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:amarū}}) is directive action bound by a preposition to the recognized good, not a free assertion of power. After the giving duty, the root also reaches toward matters and affairs, so the later closing word from the same root frames human command inside God’s ownership of outcomes. The Form I surface keeps the point on enjoining, not appointing commanders or mutual consultation, and the recognized-good formula remains tied to the rejection field that surfaces again in 22:72.

topics.headline: command takes a governed standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees command as public norm-direction tied to a recognized standard, not free-standing authority.
topics.reason: The verb keeps the same plural subject and selects a prepositional complement for the commanded content or standard.

topics.headline: human command returns as all matters
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same root moving from human command to all matters, limiting action by divine ownership of outcomes.
topics.reason: The root field links command with matter or affair, and the closing noun repeats that field inside the fronted divine ownership clause.

topics.headline: command as ordering what demands governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels command as management of affairs after resource-transfer, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as enjoining.
topics.reason: The abundance and ordering pressure is coherent but must stay subordinate to the local Form I command construction.

topics.headline: direct enjoining, not office or consultation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form names directive enjoining, not appointing commanders or mutual deliberation.
topics.reason: The local Form I surface differs from supplied Form II and Form III alternatives.

topics.headline: recognized-good formula in empowered conduct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees command of the recognized good as a formulaic governance marker, with the surah later using recognition imagery in 22:72.
topics.reason: The command-with-recognized-good formula is recurrent, and the supplied surah echo at 22:72 keeps the recognition/rejection field active.

words.gloss_range: preposition of specification and instrumentality binding the command to the recognized standard
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) prevents the command from floating alone. It binds the action to a standard and instrument, so the command is in relation to the recognized good and prepares the opposite away-from route that follows.

topics.headline: preposition binds command to the standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices command as specified by and measured through the recognized good, preparing the opposite away-from construction.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following noun and marks content, specification, and instrumentality.

words.gloss_range: the definite recognized good as governed standard, known and acknowledged rather than invented by the commanders
words.root_gloss_range: recognition, knowing, acknowledged custom, and visible knownness; the local passive participle selects the recognized good as a public standard
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَعْرُوفِ}} ({{tr:al-maʿrūfi}}) is the governed, definite standard of command. As a passive participle it presents the good as recognized and acknowledged rather than manufactured by the empowered group. The custom and raised-visibility pressure makes that standard publicly knowable, while its mirror with the rejected wrong participates in the wider command-and-prohibition formula (3:104, 3:110, 9:71).

topics.headline: definite recognized standard under command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the good as a governed and identifiable standard, not an independent detached topic.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the preposition and definite in the command frame.

topics.headline: good as already recognized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the commanded good is acknowledged as recognizable, not manufactured by the commanders.
topics.reason: The passive participle form presents the good as the thing recognized and distinguishes it from causative making-known forms.

topics.headline: recognized custom as raised visible standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the recognized good as publicly visible and knowable, while local grammar keeps it as the governed moral standard.
topics.reason: The custom and raised-visible noun field supplies image pressure without replacing the local passive-participle sense.

topics.headline: recognized and rejected form a mirror pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command-and-prohibition pair as a recognizable moral binary, attested in formulaic passages such as 3:104, 3:110, and 9:71.
topics.reason: The recognized and rejected terms share definite passive-participle morphology while carrying opposite roots and matching prepositional syntax.

words.gloss_range: coordinator that gives prohibition equal rank and completes the four-part action chain
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) gives the fourth verb the same serial rank as the first three. It completes the action chain by making negative restraint part of the response, not a secondary comment after command.

topics.headline: connector completes the four-verb chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices prohibition as coequal with the other three duties and as the completion of the governance pair.
topics.reason: The repeated conjunction attaches the fourth perfect verb to the same action chain.

words.gloss_range: outward restraint from the rejected wrong, marking a rational boundary in the governance pair
words.root_gloss_range: forbidding, restraining, endpoint, and reason as restraint; the local verb selects outward prohibition that marks a boundary
words.prose: {{ar:نَهَوْا۟}} ({{tr:nahaw}}) keeps the same plural actor and governs an away-from complement. The root’s endpoint and reason-pressure makes prohibition a rational boundary, while Form I keeps it as direct outward restraint; together with command it forms a toward-away governance axis.

topics.headline: prohibition selects separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees prohibition as boundary-making away from the rejected wrong, with the same empowered group still acting.
topics.reason: The verb governs an away-from complement and carries the same pro-dropped plural subject as the prior actions.

topics.headline: restraint as rational endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels prohibition as the drawing of a rational limit, while local grammar keeps the action as outward restraint.
topics.reason: The root evidence connects forbidding, endpoints, and reason as restraint; the local construction applies that pressure to public boundary-setting.

topics.headline: direct restraint, not mutual or reflexive stopping
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the duty as direct outward prohibition, not reciprocal negotiation or self-stopping.
topics.reason: The local Form I surface differs from supplied mutual and reflexive forms.

topics.headline: command and prohibition form opposite routes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second couplet as a complete governance axis: positive direction toward the recognized and restraint away from the rejected.
topics.reason: The formula joins opposite verbs, opposite prepositions, and matched moral nouns into one normative pair.

words.gloss_range: separative preposition that turns prohibition into movement away from the rejected domain
words.prose: {{ar:عَنِ}} ({{tr:ʿani}}) supplies the away-from route required after prohibition. It makes the rejected wrong a domain to be separated from and mirrors the earlier with/by preposition, giving the governance pair opposite directions.

topics.headline: away-from preposition for the rejected domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wrong is not merely named; it becomes a domain from which conduct is moved away.
topics.reason: The separative preposition governs the following rejected noun and mirrors the earlier with/by preposition as the opposite route.

words.gloss_range: the definite rejected wrong as a governed avoidance-domain and moral anti-pattern
words.root_gloss_range: non-recognition, denial, estrangement, reproach, and dreadfulness; the local passive participle selects the rejected wrong as an avoidance-domain
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُنكَرِ}} ({{tr:al-munkari}}) is the definite target from which restraint separates. As a passive participle it is the thing rejected or unrecognized, not the people doing denial. The non-recognition field makes the wrong feel estranged and morally alarming without turning the local noun into a punishment term, and its mirror with the recognized good makes the moral binary legible; the later surah recurrence at 22:72 keeps the rejection field active.

topics.headline: definite rejected object under separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees wrong as a known avoidance-domain governed by the away-from preposition.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the separative preposition and definite in balance with the recognized good.

topics.headline: estranged and alarming anti-pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the rejected thing as morally estranged and alarming, while the local sense remains the prohibited wrong rather than a punishment term.
topics.reason: The root evidence includes non-recognition, estrangement, severe reproach, and punishment-related forms; these give pressure but do not replace the local passive participle.

topics.headline: thing rejected, not active deniers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the form focuses on the rejected quality of the act, not on people who deny.
topics.reason: The definite passive participle differs from active-denier forms and mirrors the recognized-good form.

topics.headline: rejected wrong completes the mirror pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final governance act completing the recognition/non-recognition binary, with the rejection field recurring in 22:72.
topics.reason: The paired passive participles, opposite roots, and recurrent formulaic field make the ethical contrast legible.

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector that shifts from the conditional duty list to the sovereignty coda
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resets the discourse. After the four conditional duties, this resumptive connector opens a new sovereignty coda so the closing phrase is not read as a fifth human duty but as a declaration about who owns outcomes.

topics.headline: connector resets into sovereignty declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shift from human conditional duties to an unconditional declaration of divine ownership.
topics.reason: The connector begins a resumed nominal sentence immediately before the possessive predicate.

words.gloss_range: possessive preposition forming the fronted predicate that assigns the outcome to God first
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) puts possession at the front of the coda. Before the outcome is even named, the clause assigns it to God, making ownership lead the syntax and sharpening the restrictive force of the closing declaration.

topics.headline: possession leads the coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader meets ownership before outcome, so the syntax assigns final consequence to God from the start of the coda.
topics.reason: The possessive preposition governs the divine name and forms the fronted predicate before the subject appears.

words.gloss_range: the divine proper name as genitive possessor in the fronted outcome clause
words.root_gloss_range: worship, divinity, and awe-associated derivational dispute around the divine name; the local proper noun selects the one divine owner in the coda
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) is governed by the possessive preposition and stands as the singular divine owner, not a generic class-name or verbal subject. The coda recenters the action list in the same divine authority that defended worship and grants establishment (22:40).

topics.headline: proper divine name as possessor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the outcome concentrated in one divine referent, not in a class of authorities.
topics.reason: The proper divine name is genitive under the possessive preposition, and the supplied derivational dispute remains contained within that singular referent.

topics.headline: divine name anchors the closing restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the action list checked by the closing claim: the community acts, but outcomes belong to God, the defender named in the surrounding argument (22:40).
topics.reason: The fronted divine predicate creates restriction and re-centers the ayah after the human action sequence.

words.gloss_range: the named outcome or consequence, possessed before it is expanded to all matters
words.root_gloss_range: what follows, succession, heel, consequence, and requital; the local noun selects the outcome/consequence assigned to God
words.prose: {{ar:عَٰقِبَةُ}} ({{tr:ʿāqibatu}}) names the consequence after possession has already been fronted. Its root makes outcome feel like what follows on the heel of action, morally weighted as consequence, while the recurring formula with all matters reappears as a sovereignty closure (31:22, 57:5). The coda preserves the human action chain but denies human ownership of final results.

topics.headline: outcome subject after fronted predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees outcome as grammatically possessed before it is elaborated as the outcome of all matters.
topics.reason: The nominative abstract noun follows the fronted possessive predicate and enters an iḍāfa with the matters noun.

topics.headline: consequence follows on the heel of action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels outcome as the consequence trailing behind the whole action chain, morally answerable to God.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports following, heel, and requital pressure, while local syntax selects the noun for outcome or consequence.

topics.headline: recurring outcome formula closes governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase as a sovereignty closure also attested at 31:22 and 57:5, not a local afterthought.
topics.reason: The supplied recurrence evidence connects the same outcome-of-matters formula across passages.

topics.headline: human action remains under divine consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the coda preserving human action while denying human ownership of final results.
topics.reason: The resumptive connector, fronted possession, and matters echo combine to limit agency without erasing the duty list.

words.gloss_range: the definite plural field of all matters, widening the close beyond the four named duties
words.root_gloss_range: command, matter, affair, and concern; the local broken plural selects all matters or affairs whose outcome belongs to God
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأُمُورِ}} ({{tr:al-umūri}}) completes the construct by widening the outcome to the whole field of affairs. Because it shares the command/matter root with the earlier human command, the final word gathers those commands into all matters and leaves their outcomes with God, absorbing the broader defense argument from 22:40.

topics.headline: definite plural widens the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word expanding beyond the four named duties to the whole field of affairs and the preceding argument (22:40).
topics.reason: The definite broken plural completes the construct as genitive complement and gives the coda comprehensive scope.

topics.headline: human command absorbed into all matters
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the earlier human command return as all matters, placing every command and concern under divine ownership of outcomes.
topics.reason: The same root field links command, matter, and affair, and the final noun echoes the earlier command verb inside the sovereignty coda.

branches.scope_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.scope_en: Covers worship, devotion, and a being or thing treated as an object of worship, including deity, idols, and the sun when named for being worshipped.

variants.scope_en: Covers worship, devotion, and a being or thing treated as an object of worship, including deity, idols, and the sun when named for being worshipped.

branches.scope_en: Covers the fixed divine name and oath or invocation formulas built on it, including Allah, O Allah, and reduced/formulaic forms cited by the dictionaries.

branches.image_en: the lower ground opposite the sky
branches.scope_ar: الأرض التي نحن عليها؛ كل ما سفل وقابل السماء؛ أسفل الشيء وقوائم الدابة وما يلي الأرض منها

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional إن مكناهم, the two uses of ء م ر, and the closing ولله عاقبة الأمور bracket human action between granted capacity and an outcome owned by God.
baseline_models.mechanism: Empowerment is a conditional grant that creates custodial responsibility. إقامة activates maintenance and care, while the shift from commanding to the totality of affairs prevents the empowered group from treating its command as ultimate sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: The capacity-and-empowerment branch makes rule a granted ability and the condition of the test.
The care, preservation, and governance branch turns إقامة into sustained custodianship rather than one ritual gesture.
The authority-holder branch gives public force to commanding while keeping that force inside a delegated office.
The affairs-and-condition branch widens the final occurrence from one command to the whole field whose outcome escapes human ownership.
The last-part and outcome branch supplies the terminal audit that limits the preceding exercise of authority.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists the conduct of rulers after they gain power.
changed_reading.after: The ayah tests recipients of a conditional grant: they must maintain worship, provision, and public restraint while knowing that neither authority nor its outcome belongs to them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The four coordinated perfect verbs أقاموا, آتوا, أمروا, and نهوا form the response to one condition of empowerment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The actions work as a coupled maintenance system: worship supplies orientation, giving makes resources move, zakat produces growth and repair, recognized good gives positive direction, and prohibition provides a stopping boundary against publicly deforming conduct.

activation_trace.role: The support, subsistence, and system branch makes إقامة the load-bearing maintenance of communal life.
The specified-worship branch anchors one component in recurrent embodied prayer rather than generic policy.
The giving branch supplies an outward transfer, making provision a performed movement rather than an attitude.
The growth-and-increase branch makes redistribution productive of renewed communal capacity.
The purification-and-repair branch adds a corrective function to the same transfer without displacing its growth function.
The good recognized by self, reason, and norm gives public positive direction to the system.
The rebuke-and-restraint branch supplies an active boundary against harmful action.
The repelled ugly branch identifies the negative pole as conduct requiring resistance, not merely private dislike.

changed_reading.before: Prayer, zakat, commanding good, and forbidding wrong are four adjacent virtues.
changed_reading.after: They are interdependent public infrastructure: orientation, circulation, constructive norm formation, and restraint must remain coupled for empowerment to count as sound.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opposition between المعروف and المنكر is built from recognition and non-recognition, and it sits between human command and God's ownership of the outcome.
baseline_models.mechanism: Public moral action requires discernment rather than bare assertion. Recognition follows signs, consultation manages judgment, reason restrains the ugly, and review remains possible because what appears unfamiliar or objectionable can reflect either real deformation or failed recognition.

activation_trace.role: The consultation-and-deliberation branch makes command a reasoned public process rather than an isolated fiat.
Recognition after a trace or sign makes the positive norm evidentially discoverable rather than self-certifying.
The contrary-to-recognition branch preserves the epistemic gap between what is known and what is denied or unrecognized.
The change into something unknown or disliked keeps open the possibility that estrangement itself shapes the negative judgment.
The intellect-that-restrains branch makes prohibition depend on disciplined judgment as well as coercive stopping.
The review-and-reconsideration branch makes moral administration answerable to later examination.

changed_reading.before: The empowered group applies already obvious labels of good and evil.
changed_reading.after: The empowered group must sustain a corrigible practice of recognition, deliberation, restraint, and review while refusing to make its own recognition final.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence identifies the prospective empowered as people attacked, wronged, and expelled, then frames defensive permission as دفع that prevents demolition of multiple kinds of worship space. Their later power is therefore restorative counterpower whose first logic is protection from dispossession and destruction.

activation_trace.role: Granted capacity anchors the contextual defense reading back in the conditional empowerment of the focus ayah.
Care and preservation make the empowered response one of maintaining what violence threatened.
The permission branch marks force as licensed in response to a stated condition, not self-authorizing expansion.
Withholding or confining a right supplies the concrete injustice to which permission responds.
Vindication of the wronged makes aid restorative rather than a prize for dominance.
Passage forcibly outside a place supplies displacement as the social injury preceding empowerment.
Pushing away harm gives reciprocal force a protective and limiting function.
The building-collapse branch identifies the institutional destruction that defensive power averts.
The worship-place branch extends the protected field beyond one group's ritual building to a plurality of sites.

structural_cues: The relative الذين in 22:41 immediately follows the الذين أخرجوا description in 22:40.
The sequence runs permission after injustice, prevention of demolished worship sites, conditional empowerment, then public duties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attack, injustice, expulsion, defensive pushing, threatened worship sites, and then conditional empowerment; I infer that protection and restoration define the purpose of the later power. A live alternative is that 22:40 justifies defense generally without specifying every later institution.

changed_reading.before: The ayah describes a generic program for any successful religious government.
changed_reading.after: The ayah first describes post-dispossession trusteeship: power is legitimate as bounded protection that restores rights and keeps diverse worship spaces from being destroyed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Equal access to the sanctuary, repeated commands to feed, explicit need, and a recipient who can be read as either content or asking turn zakat into reachable provision. The contrast between what does not reach God and protective orientation that does shifts ritual value away from display and toward socially delivered care.

activation_trace.role: Actual giving anchors the contextual feeding sequence in the focus ayah's required transfer.
Growth makes the transfer answerable to whether recipients and communal capacity can flourish.
Equality between two parties makes access, resident and visitor alike, part of the distributive field.
Feeding another supplies the concrete outward destination of ritual provision.
Material need identifies the vulnerable recipient rather than leaving giving socially indeterminate.
Contentment preserves the recipient who does not press a claim as a proper object of provision.
The asking branch preserves the coexisting reading of an explicit petitioner, widening rather than resolving the recipient profile.
Reaching supplies the contrast between external sacrificial matter that does not arrive and orientation that does.
Protection from harm gives taqwa a practical orientation that disciplines the handling of provision.

structural_cues: 22:28 and 22:36 repeat the imperative to eat and feed, naming poor, content, and asking recipients.
22:37 contrasts flesh and blood with taqwa through the repeated verb of reaching.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equality of access, concrete feeding, named need, plural recipient postures, and a reach/non-reach contrast; I infer that zakat in 22:41 is measured by delivered care rather than ceremonial transfer. A live alternative is that these are pilgrimage distributions that only analogically inform zakat.

changed_reading.before: Giving zakat is a badge accompanying established worship.
changed_reading.after: Giving zakat is the circulation arm of worship: provision must cross social distance, reach both visible and quiet need, and produce protected communal growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated delay is followed by a settlement whose roofs collapse while its well is disabled and its fortified palace remains as a monument. Travel and heart-reason turn this landscape into an audit: the عاقبة of affairs is legible in whether life-supporting systems remain inhabited and usable, not in impressive construction alone.

activation_trace.role: The terminal-outcome branch anchors the ruined landscape as one possible historical disclosure of consequence.
The affairs branch makes the material audit bear on the whole managed condition, not only isolated commands.
Extended time and respite separate present power from its eventual assessment.
Collapse and falling make failed order physically visible in the settlement.
The well supplies the ordinary life-supporting infrastructure against which monumental success is tested.
Emptiness and disabling turn the well from an asset into evidence of social abandonment.
The raised and fortified building supplies durable prestige that can coexist with failed communal life.
Movement through the land makes consequences observable rather than merely asserted.
Reason that restrains ignorance converts the observed ruins into institutional learning.
Repeated respite confirms that delay is part of the mechanism and is not evidence of a favorable outcome.

structural_cues: 22:45 juxtaposes collapsed habitation, a disabled well, and a fortified palace.
22:44 and 22:48 repeat divine respite around the invitation in 22:46 to travel and reason with hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delayed seizure, ruined habitation, an idle well, an impressive palace, travel, and reasoning; I infer that the contrast audits provisioning against prestige. A live alternative is that the images signify destruction generally rather than a specific critique of institutional priorities.

changed_reading.before: God's ownership of the outcome refers only to a remote final verdict.
changed_reading.after: Without displacing final judgment, the outcome also leaves delayed historical evidence: a polity can preserve monuments while losing the wells and inhabited life that reveal whether its duties worked.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence of material being cast into communication, removed and replaced, then made secure presents truth-bearing as an error-correcting process. Its assay reveals disequilibrium and hardened hearts, while receptive hearts become low and settled; this revises المعروف والمنكر into norms requiring correction, testing, and humility.

activation_trace.role: Recognition after a sign anchors the contextual correction sequence in the focus ayah's positive norm.
Transformation into the unknown or disliked makes failed recognition a live risk in naming the negative norm.
Reason that restrains ugly action makes disciplined discernment part of prohibition.
Casting something into a field supplies the intrusive input that the correction mechanism must expose.
Deviation, crookedness, and severity characterize the contaminating input without making it an independent theme.
Removal followed by replacement supplies explicit correction rather than mere suppression.
Securing and making firm supplies the stabilization phase after correction.
Assaying metal or persons makes disturbance diagnostically reveal the quality of receivers.
Departure from health and balance identifies one failure mode in receiving and judging a message.
Loss of the heart's softness supplies a second, resistant failure mode.
Low, wide, settled ground gives receptive humility a spatial counterimage to hardened resistance.

structural_cues: 22:52 repeats يلقي around the ordered sequence ينسخ ثم يحكم.
22:53-54 contrasts diseased or hard hearts with hearts that settle humbly after knowing the truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intrusion, removal-with-replacement, securing, assay, and contrasting heart conditions; I infer an analogy from protected revelation to corrigible civic discernment. The materially live alternative is that this correction sequence is unique to prophetic communication and should not be generalized into a governance procedure.

changed_reading.before: Commanding recognized good means enforcing a fixed inventory whose application is transparent.
changed_reading.after: Commanding good and forbidding wrong also require error correction: claims must be tested, contamination removed, judgments secured, and the judging heart kept receptive rather than hardened.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root as عاقبة becomes reciprocal punishment, immediately measured by equivalence; renewed aggression then draws aid, yet the sequence closes with pardon and protective covering. Forbidding wrong is thus calibrated intervention with an off-ramp, not an unlimited mandate to escalate.

activation_trace.role: Active restraint anchors proportional response in the focus ayah's duty to stop harm.
The combat-and-hostility branch exposes the escalation risk latent in opposing wrong.
Punishment following an offense activates consequence as reciprocal response rather than only final outcome.
Likeness and equivalence set a measure on the response.
Crossing the limit through aggression identifies the renewed violation that warrants aid.
Vindication of the wronged directs aid toward restoration rather than retaliatory surplus.
Leaving punishment and erasing the offense supplies a genuine exit from the punitive cycle.
Covering the offense while protecting its bearer from the residue supplies restorative closure.

structural_cues: 22:60 uses reciprocal morphology and بِمِثْلِ before naming a second act of aggression.
The verse moves from measured response and promised aid to the paired attributes عفو and غفور.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal punishment, explicit equivalence, transgression, aid, pardon, and covering; I infer that the public restraint of 22:41 should be proportionate and designed to terminate retaliation. A live alternative is that 22:60 governs an individual victim's response and only indirectly constrains institutions.

changed_reading.before: Forbidding wrong licenses suppression until the wrong disappears.
changed_reading.after: Forbidding wrong is bounded by equivalence, protection of the wronged, and a real path from coercive response into pardon and repaired safety.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dispute over ritual affairs is routed toward invitation and deferred judgment; later, opponents visibly register المنكر and nearly assault reciters. The recurrence demonstrates that felt or facial recognition can be partisan and violent, so the focus pair cannot be reduced to factional familiarity and disgust.

activation_trace.role: Recognition by a trace anchors the delta in the focus ayah's claim that good must be knowable through evidence.
Non-recognition supplies the unstable negative pole whose recurrence in hostile faces tests the baseline.
Mutual pulling between two sides makes ritual difference an active contest rather than a settled classification.
The affairs branch connects that contest directly to the same semantic field as the focus ayah's commands and affairs.
Judgment between people places final resolution of the dispute outside immediate factional coercion.
Each party taking a different path preserves genuine disagreement instead of pretending recognition is uniform.
Recognition from a visible sign reappears on faces, but now as a prelude to hostile misclassification.
Something rendered unfamiliar or disliked shows how estrangement can be experienced as wrongness.
Nearness to performing an act turns hostile recognition into an imminent behavioral danger.
The split root's fighting branch keeps an exploratory combat image alive beside the dominant near-action reading.

structural_cues: The branchless س ط و occurrence at 22:72 word 13 supplies imminent assault structurally and is not assigned an invented branch.
22:67-69 routes contest through دعوتك إلى ربك, divine knowledge, and later judgment before 22:72 stages violent face-reading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ritual dispute, deferred judgment, facial recognition of munkar, near-action, and branchless assault; I infer that immediate disgust can masquerade as moral recognition and therefore cannot alone authorize coercion. A live alternative is that تعرف المنكر narrates the narrator's accurate reading of their expression, not the opponents' own moral classification.

changed_reading.before: Whatever a community readily recognizes as good or repellent can be directly enforced by those in power.
changed_reading.after: Recognition is contested and can become a pretext for assault; public command therefore needs evidence, invitation, restraint, and humility before the judgment the group does not own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fly scene defeats totalized agency: even gathered force cannot create a small life or extract what it takes, and seeker and sought are both weak. Conditional empowerment in the focus ayah therefore grants actionable capacity without granting comprehensive control.

activation_trace.role: Capacity and empowerment anchor the later inability scene as a limit on granted human efficacy.
Public authority supplies the institutional actor whose competence must not be mistaken for sovereignty.
The literal fly supplies the deliberately small agent that exposes disproportionate human inability.
Restless and wavering movement explains why the apparently minor agent remains hard to master.
Gathering force until its parts cohere maximizes collective capacity before the stated failure.
Extraction from another's grasp supplies the precise recovery operation that remains beyond the actors.
The contrary-to-strength branch names limitation on both sides of the pursuit.
Claiming and exacting a right sharpens the failure as inability to recover even what is treated as due.

structural_cues: 22:73 sets ولو اجتمعوا against لن يخلقوا and لا يستنقذوه.
The branchless س ل ب occurrence at word 20 supplies seizure structurally, while شيء at word 22 minimizes what cannot be recovered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathered capacity, a small seizing agent, failed extraction, and paired weakness; I infer a warning against reading تمكين as total administrative mastery. A live alternative is that the scene targets worship of powerless objects and bears on political power only by analogy.

changed_reading.before: Once empowered, the group possesses the efficacy needed to order society through its commands.
changed_reading.after: Empowerment supplies a bounded tool, not mastery: institutions remain unable to create, control, or recover everything and must govern with acknowledged fragility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement says that affairs return to God, broadens responsibility into reciprocal witnessing, repeats إقامة الصلاة and إيتاء الزكاة almost verbatim, and adds holding fast. This turns the focus profile from a ruler-only platform into a community-wide witness practice whose cohesion and final reference remain external to its own power.

activation_trace.role: The final-outcome branch anchors the closure's explicit return of affairs in the focus ayah.
Return and restoration make explicit the direction only implied by the focus ayah's outcome.
The affairs branch creates a direct lexical reprise: the entire managed field returns to God.
Presence with witnessing recasts public moral work as accountable testimony rather than ownership.
Knowledgeable declaration gives the witness role an evidential, communicative function.
The repeated imperative to maintain and preserve prayer extends custodianship to the addressed community.
The exact worship recurrence ties the closing communal vocation to the focus ayah's first practice.
Repeated giving confirms outward transfer as part of the shared witness vocation.
Repeated growth links the community's provision to durable flourishing rather than a one-time payment.
Holding that prevents and preserves supplies cohesion without making the community self-sufficient.

structural_cues: 22:76 restates the focus ending as وإلى الله ترجع الأمور.
22:78 shifts to direct plural address, names reciprocal witness, and repeats فأقيموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a direct return-of-affairs reprise, reciprocal witnessing, exact repetition of prayer and zakat, and holding fast; I infer that 22:41's governance profile also belongs to a broader communal witness office. A live alternative is that the closure reiterates shared duties without changing the narrower political referent of 22:41.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah assigns a distinctive checklist to a future ruling class.
changed_reading.after: The focus ayah concentrates a community-wide vocation of accountable witness: empowered office intensifies duties shared by the believers, while all affairs return beyond them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates form-distant watercourse, fertile-ground, growth, and terminal-basin branches rather than ordinary lexical glosses. It remains valid as a material analogy anchored in آتوا, الزكاة, الأرض, أقاموا, and نهوا and is reinforced by the packet's water-to-green-earth sequence. Downstream prose should label it an exploratory hydraulic model, never a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ayah places granted capacity in الأرض and coordinates maintaining, giving, growth, and setting a prohibition boundary.

activation_trace.role: Soft germinating ground turns the land from neutral territory into a substrate whose response can be cultivated.
Support, subsistence, and system supply the sustaining structure of the cultivation analogy.
A watercourse and the opening of its path recast giving as directed flow through public channels.
Increase and growth supply the intended yield of the directed flow.
A basin at the end of a flood gives prohibition the analogical role of a boundary that catches destructive overflow.
Delivering water by irrigation supplies the contextual flow that activates the focus ayah's channel image.
The repeated fertile-ground branch links the land of empowerment to a visible capacity for renewed life.
Fresh green growth supplies the observable output by which the social irrigation analogy is judged.

changed_reading.before: The earth is simply the jurisdiction in which empowered people perform duties.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the earth is a social growing medium: authority must maintain channels that move provision into growth while boundaries catch destructive overflow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the race image of the second horse following the leader from the prayer root. It remains anchored in الصلاة and in the immediate order from wronged defenders and protected worship sites to إقامة الصلاة. Downstream prose should present only the sequencing analogy: protection leads and public ritual follows; it must not claim that the branch is the lexical sense of prayer here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Prayer is the first named practice after conditional empowerment, but the preceding context has already staged defense of victims and worship places.

activation_trace.role: The horse following the leader supplies an analogical sequence in which established prayer comes behind prior protective justice.
A right withheld identifies the victim-centered condition that leads the sequence.
Protective pushing supplies the action that precedes and enables secure public worship.
Threatened building collapse makes protection of institutions concrete rather than ceremonial.
Worship places identify what protective justice keeps standing before the empowered establish their own prayer.

changed_reading.before: Established prayer heads the empowered group's platform and independently legitimates it.
changed_reading.after: In the exploratory race sequence, ritual follows protection: prayer cannot substitute for defending the wronged and keeping worship spaces standing.

strongest_changes: Immediate context revises empowerment into restorative counterpower for people wronged and expelled, bounded by protection of plural worship space.
Prayer and zakat become coupled public maintenance and socially delivered provision rather than status badges.
The recurrence of recognition and munkar in a scene of imminent assault makes moral recognition contested and demands corrigibility and restraint.
The outcome of affairs gains both a delayed material audit in ruined settlements and an explicit return to God in the closing reprise.
The final repetition broadens the focus profile into a community-wide vocation of accountable witness while preserving the special burden of empowered office.
summary.what_was_special: The trace was driven by two reversals: human command is enclosed by God's grant and God's ownership of affairs, and apparently straightforward recognition of good and wrong is later destabilized by hostile face-reading. Material branches also kept live coexisting models of cultivation, provisioning, ruined infrastructure, bounded force, and fragile efficacy.
remaining_uncertainties: The immediate الذين link strongly favors the expelled defenders as antecedent, but the ayah may also state a wider type of legitimate empowerment.
The error-correction sequence is explicitly about protected revelation; its extension to civic discernment remains analogical.
The hydraulic and race-sequence outliers are branch-backed material analogies, not proposed lexical substitutions.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Enablement is tested by sustaining public good.** `م ك ن B003/B005` supplies place and enablement; `ق و م B004/B009` maintenance and support; `ز ك و B001/B002` growth and purity; `ع ر ف B005` recognized good; `ن ه ي B001/B003` restraint from wrong; `ن ك ر B006` the condemned thing corrected. I infer that territorial capacity is a means whose valid output is worship, circulation, recognition, and restraint. Power reads as accountable enablement, not possession.
2. **Every command returns to an outcome beyond rulers.** `ء م ر B001/B002` appears both in commanding and in plural affairs; `ع ق ب B005/B006` is succession and final outcome. The verse closes human directives by assigning the end of affairs to God. I infer that governance is temporally provisional and judged by what follows from it. The final clause limits self-authorization by making consequences divine property.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:78's maintained prayer, growth-giving alms, witnessing, and holdfast gathered this political test into a final communal operating pattern.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Enablement is tested by what power causes to stand and circulate.** Fixed `مَّكَّنَّاهُم` activates `م ك ن:B005` (ability and enablement), grounded in `ء ر ض:B001`. Its outputs are `ق و م:B003` (rising to undertake) with prescribed worship (`ص ل و:B003`), granting (`ء ت ي:B002`) growth/purification (`ز ك و:B001/B002`), commanding (`ء م ر:B002`) recognized good (`ع ر ف:B005`), and restraining (`ن ه ي:B001`) the condemned (`ن ك ر:B006`). `22:39-40` supplied authorized defense; `22:42-45` supply the ruin of communities whose order failed. The packet gives power and a list of public outputs; I infer that these outputs are the criteria by which enablement remains legitimate. Victory reads as institutional responsibility, not possession alone.
2. **The outcome clause prevents power from closing around itself.** Fixed `عَاقِبَة` activates `ع ق ب:B006` (end and outcome), while `ٱلْأُمُور` uses `ء م ر:B001` (affairs). After listing human acts under enabled conditions, the syntax returns their terminal course to God. I infer a limit on claims of sovereign finality. Human authority manages intermediate affairs but does not own their outcome.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `22:42-45` make the outcome clause concrete through repeated communal failure and ruined settlements, while `22:46` makes reflective travel the safeguard against reproducing that outcome.

baseline.text: Onlar, yeryüzünde kendilerine imkân verdiğimizde namazı kılar, zekâtı verir, iyiliği emreder ve kötülüğü yasaklarlar. İşlerin sonu Allah'a aittir.

findings.text: Yeryüzünde güç verilmesinin sınavı, iktidarın namazı ayakta tutması, paylaşımı dolaştırması ve kamusal iyiliği sürdürmesidir.
İşlerin sonucunun Allah'a ait olması, iktidarın kendi amacı çevresinde kapanmasını önler.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalın merkezini kertenkelenin ve benzer hayvanların yumurtaları olarak kurar; dişi kertenkelenin ya da çekirgenin yumurtaları karnında toplaması ve bu durumdaki hayvan da aynı dalın eylem ve durum uzantılarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal kuş yuvasını, genel yeri, toplumsal değeri veya bitki adını değil, yumurtayı ve yumurtaların karında toplanmasıyla ilgili kullanımları kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yumurta adını çekirdek olarak korur; hayvanı niteleyen kalıpları ve yumurtaları karında toplama eylemini bu çekirdekten ayrı, bağımlı kullanımlar olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Kertenkelenin ve benzer hayvanların yumurtalarını belirtir. Ayrıca dişi kertenkelenin veya çekirgenin yumurtaları karnında toplamasını ve bu durumdaki hayvanı anlatan kullanımları kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel gönderim, kertenkelenin ve ona benzetilen hayvanların yumurtalarıdır.
Tekil biçim, bu yumurtalardan birini belirtir.
Eylem ve niteleme kullanımları, dişi kertenkele ya da çekirgenin yumurtaları karnında toplamasını ve bu durumdaki hayvanı anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Adlandırma öncelikle kertenkelenin yumurtalarını ve bunlardan birini kapsar; yumurtaları karnında toplamış dişi kertenkele ile aynı durumdaki çekirgeye ve bu toplama eylemine de uygulanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın merkezindeki yumurta adını doğal ve kısa biçimde karşılar; eylem ve hayvan durumu ayrı bağlamsal anlatımlarla verilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kuşlarla kurulan sözün yuva, bulunulan yer veya kuşun üzerinde durduğu hâl diye açıklandığını gösterir; ancak bu biçimin kuşlar için asli olmadığı, benzetmeyle kurulduğu veya başka bir biçimin doğru sayıldığı yönünde açık bir çekince de taşır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca kuşlarla kurulan söz içinde geçerlidir; genel bir yer adı veya kuş yumurtası anlamına genişletilemez ve biçim üzerindeki kaynak çekincesi korunmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnızca kuşları konu alan sabit sözle tanımlanır; yuva, yer ve konmuş olma açıklamaları çıplak kökün genel anlamı gibi sunulmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kuşlarla kurulan belirli bir söz içinde, kuşların yuvalarını, bulundukları yerleri veya üzerinde kararlı biçimde durdukları hâli belirtir. Kullanımın asli biçimi tartışmalı olup benzetmeye ya da biçim değişmesine bağlanan açıklamalar da vardır.

facets.statement: Söz içindeki temel gönderim, kuşların yuvaları veya bulundukları yerlerdir.
Aynı söz, kuşların görüldükleri biçimde konmuş ve yerleşmiş olma hâli diye de açıklanır.
Bazı açıklamalar kuşlara özgü bu biçimi kabul etmez; onu benzetme sayar veya yakın bir başka biçimin beklendiğini bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Sabit söz, kuşların yuvaları, bulundukları yerler ya da kondukları hâl için açıklanır; bunun kuşlara özgü asli bir adlandırma olmadığı, benzetmeyle kullanıldığı veya başka bir biçimin beklendiği de aktarılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı açıkça ilkbahar otlarından bir bitki, bu türden tek bir örnek ve söz konusu bitkinin yetiştiği dere yatağı kullanımı olarak tanımlar; provisional bitki çerçevesi bu kapsamı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca bu ilkbahar otu, tek örneği ve yetiştiği dere yatağını anlatan yapıyla sınırlıdır; yumurta, genel yer ve güç yetirme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bitki türü ile bu türden tek bitki ad düzeyinde tutulur; bitkinin yetiştiği dere yatağı anlamı yalnızca verilen niteleme yapısına bağlanır.

facets.statement: Temel gönderim, ilkbaharda yetişen otlardan bir bitki türüdür.

Belirli bir niteleme, bu bitkinin yetiştiği dere yatağını anlatır.

concept_map.definition: Göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan, üzerinde yaşadığımız yer küresini belirtir. Belirli tamlamalarda bir şeyin yere bakan altını ve hayvanın tırnağını ya da ayağının alt bölümünü de anlatır.

facets.statement: Göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan ve üzerinde yaşanan yer küresidir.
Bir şeyin yere bakan alt bölümü, belirli bir tamlama içinde bu adla anılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yumuşak, iyi ve verimli toprağı merkez alır; bitkinin köklenip çoğalması veya biçilecek duruma gelmesi ile oğlağın bu ottan yiyip semirmesi buna bağlı gelişmelerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Toprağın niteliği çekirdektir; bitkinin gelişmesi ve oğlağın beslenmesi sonuç ya da ilişkili kullanım olarak kalmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, nitelikli toprak anlamını yalnız kanıtlanan tamlamalara; bitki, fidan ve oğlakla ilgili anlamları da kendi kanıtlanmış yapılarına bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Belirtilen yapılarda yumuşak, iyi, verimli ve bol bitki yetiştiren toprağı anlatır. Buna bağlı yapılarda bitkinin toprağa iyice yerleşip çoğalması veya biçilebilir olması, köklü fidan ve yer bitkisini yiyen oğlak; ayrı bir kaynak kullanımında ise semiz oğlak ifade edilir.

facets.statement: Toprak veya çayırlık yumuşak, verimli ve iyi bitki yetiştirir.
Bitki toprağa iyice yerleşir, çoğalır veya biçilecek olgunluğa ulaşır.
Oğlak yer bitkisini yer.
Bir kaynakta ilgili niteleme semiz oğlağı belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleşik kanıt, verimli ve yumuşak toprağı; bu toprakta gelişen bitkiyi ve bitkiden yararlanan oğlağı aynı üretkenlik ilişkisi içinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın toprak niteliğine dayanan çekirdeğini eksiksiz ve doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Toprağın yumuşaklığını, iyiliğini, verimini ve bitki yetiştirme gücünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bitkinin toprağa yerleşerek çoğalması anlatılan bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkinin toprağa yerleşmesi ve gelişerek çoğalması sürecini korur.
error_profile.loses: Toprağın genel niteliğini ve oğlağın bu bitkiyle beslenmesi yüzünü dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli yapılarda bir kişinin iyiliğe yatkın, ona layık ve alçak gönüllü oluşunu; karşılaştırmalı yapıda ise bir işi yapmaya en uygun kişi sayılmasını bildirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız verilen kişi ve eylem yapılarında geçerlidir; genel bir kök anlamı veya doğrudan ahlaki iyilik adı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bütünüyle belirtilen kişi ve eylem tamlamalarına bağlıdır; yalın biçime bağımsız bir uygunluk anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yapılarda bir kişinin iyiliğe yatkın ve ona layık olmasını anlatır; bir kaynak bu niteliği alçak gönüllülükle birlikte verir. Karşılaştırmalı kullanımda ise bir işi yapmaya başkalarından daha uygun olmayı bildirir.

facets.statement: Kişi iyiliğe yatkın ve ona layıktır.
Karşılaştırmalı yapıda kişi, belirli bir işi yapmaya grubun en uygun üyesidir.
Bir kaynak bu kişi niteliğini alçak gönüllülükle birlikte verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi nesneyi kalın, büyükçe bir yaygı olarak tanımlar ve malzemesini yün ya da hayvan kılıyla sınırlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişinin yere bağlı kalmasını, yere doğru ağırlaşmasını ve bunun sonucu oyalanıp gecikmesini aynı hareket durumu içinde verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yere yönelen ağırlık ve kalma durumudur; tembellik, geri kayma veya bir başkasına karşı çıkma değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın eylem dalının yere bağlı kalma, ağırlaşma ve gecikme bileşenleriyle sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin yere bağlı kalmasını veya yere çökercesine ağırlaşmasını ve bu yüzden bir süre oyalanıp gecikmesini anlatır.

facets.statement: Kişi yerden ayrılmayarak yere bağlı kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kişiler arası karşıya çıkışı öne çıkarır; komşu dal bakma, gözetme ve genel yüzünü dönme kullanımlarını da kapsar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hastalık çekirdeğini Türkçede en doğal ve ayırt edici biçimde karşılar.
